title: BLOOM: A 176B-Parameter Open-Access Multilingual Language Model
before: Large models were built inside single companies and released, if at all, on their terms.
problem: No model of that scale had been built by an open scientific collaboration, and none covered many languages well.
breakthrough: A 176B multilingual model trained in public by a thousand researchers on a national supercomputer, released with a responsible-use licence.
why: It proved a large model could be built as open science, and put multilingual coverage on the agenda.
next: The RAIL licence influenced later custom licences; the collaboration model informed open data efforts.
inherits: Open collaborative training, and the idea of use-restricted rather than fully free licences.
